metricReorderBasis: At or below the minimum, of {n} items in use
metricAwaitingBasis: Orders you have not approved yet
metricStockOutsBasis: Items that fell to 0 in the last 7 days
metricStockOutsUnknown: The movement history could not be read
loadFailedTitle: The stock data could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: Reload the page in a few minutes.
failed: Something went wrong, try again later.
pendingHint: Sending an order to a supplier and big stock changes always ask you first.
stockEmptyBody: Add items, paste a sheet or load a starter set in the Import tab.
stockQuickWaiting: This change was sent to you for approval.
stockDrafted: {n} purchase orders drafted, see the Orders tab.
stockDraftedNone: The low items already have orders on the way.
itemDrawerHint: Quantities are always in the base unit; other units (box, kg) convert to it.
itemSkuHint: Leave empty and NIVO picks one.
itemUnitsHint: For example: box=24, kg=1000 (1 box is 24 base units)
itemReorderPointHint: At this level NIVO drafts a purchase order.
itemAliasesHint: Separated by commas. Helps NIVO deduct stock when an order uses another name.
adjustPreviewSmall: {from} → {to} {unit}. A small change, applied at once.
adjustPreviewBig: {from} → {to} {unit}. A big change (about {value}), needs your approval.
adjustWaiting: A big change, so it was sent to you for approval (see Waiting for you above).
orderEmptyBody: When items reach their minimum, NIVO drafts orders per supplier. You can also create one yourself.
orderCopyNote: Approved, copy the message and send it by {channel}
poTotal: Set a quantity of 0 to drop a line. Estimated {total}.
poReceiveHint: Enter what actually arrived (a part is fine) and the real price; the cost is recomputed as an average.
poInvoiceHint: With an invoice NIVO hands the payable to Accounting if you use the Accounting agent.
poMessageHint: Drafted by NIVO; you can edit it before approving.
poSendForApproval: Draft the message and send for approval
poSentForApproval: The message was drafted and sent to you for approval.
poReminded: A reminder was drafted, waiting for your approval.
newPoHint: Choose a supplier and items. The order starts as a draft; you send it for approval later.
supplierEmptyBody: Add who you buy from so NIVO groups orders correctly.
supplierDrawerHint: The channel decides how orders reach them: email is sent directly; for Zalo and phone NIVO drafts a message to copy.
locationsText: {count, plural, =0 {No places yet: the main one is created with the first item.} other {{list}}} Add more only if you have several shops or warehouses.
historyEmptyBody: Every receipt, sale, adjustment or count is recorded here with its reason and author.
recipeEmptyBody: For cafes, spas, workshops: a product made of several ingredients. Goods sold whole do not need one.
recipeDrawerHint: How much of each ingredient one cup, portion or treatment uses. When an order is confirmed the stock is deducted.
recipeNameHint: Exactly as on the order, for example: milk coffee
countIntro: Count each item and type what you counted. A blank box is not counted yet. A small gap is fixed at once; a big one waits for the owner.
countEmptyBody: Add items in the Stock or Import tab.
countWaiting: , {n} big gaps are waiting for your approval
importDeniedTitle: Only the owner or a manager imports data
importDeniedBody: You can still count and adjust stock in the other tabs.
importPasteTitle: Paste a sheet from Excel or CSV
importPasteHelp: Copy rows from a spreadsheet and paste them here. The first row should name the columns (Name, Unit, Group, Cost, Price, Minimum, Order quantity, Stock, Supplier, Code). Without a header NIVO reads them in that order starting with the code. An existing code is updated, a new one is added.
importPastePlaceholder:
Name	Unit	Cost	Minimum	Stock	Supplier
Coffee beans	g	250	2000	6000	Phu Loc
importDone: Imported: {created} new, {updated} updated, {stocked} with an opening quantity{skipped}.
importSkipped: ; {n} rows without a name were skipped
starterFooter: Loads a sample list of items, suppliers and recipes to edit. Existing codes are kept.
